editorial: In the software world today, there is a keen interest in self-hosting practices and the context engineering capabilities of large language models. New models and academic studies shared on the Hugging Face platform are increasing the technical depth regarding the structural optimization of artificial intelligence systems.

items.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter is a Claude Code plugin package containing 85 skills and 16 slash commands developed for bug hunting and external red-team operations. Written in Python, this tool offers corporate identity and infrastructure attack matrices with 681 report patterns across 24 core vulnerability classes.

snapshot.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 85 skills, 16 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: obra/superpowers is a capability framework and software development methodology developed for AI coding agents. It aims to standardize software development processes for agents through composable skills and prompting instructions.

snapshot.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works. Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

items.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
items.summary: CLI-Anything is a command-line interface (CLI) tool that makes various software suitable for use by AI agents. This system aims to facilitate the integrated operation of AI-powered coding and automation tools, such as Pi or Claude Code, with different software.

snapshot.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: One Command Line: Make any software agent-ready for Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc. 中文文档 | 日本語ドキュメント | Deutsch

items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.summary: MiniMind is an open-source project that allows you to train a 64M parameter large language model (LLM) from scratch in two hours. Offered under the Apache 2.0 license, this work provides users with the opportunity to create their own artificial intelligence models.

snapshot.description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours. MiniMind 以 Apache 2.0 协议完全开源、永久免费。赞助完全自愿，不换取任何特权，也不影响项目使用。感谢每一位支持者，让这个业余时间维护的项目得以持续。

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Cursor offers a repository hosting the technical standards and official extensions developed for the code editor Cursor. Prepared in TypeScript, this resource allows developers to understand and contribute to the platform's specific extension ecosystem.

snapshot.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins

items.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
items.summary: Firecrawl is an information infrastructure that offers search and data scraping operations from over 550 sources via a single API to facilitate data access for AI agents. This tool, which developers can host on their own servers, comes with software development kits (SDKs) that simplify application development.

snapshot.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API. Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥 You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three.

items.title: nginx/nginx
items.summary: NGINX is an open-source software used as a web server, load balancer, reverse proxy, API gateway, and content cache. Developed in the C language, this project provides high-performance network traffic management solutions.

snapshot.description: The official NGINX Open Source repository. NGINX (pronounced "engine x" or "en-jin-eks") is the world's most popular Web Server, high performance Load Balancer, Reverse Proxy, API Gateway and Content Cache.

items.title: openvinotoolkit/openvino
items.summary: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit used to optimize and deploy the inference processes of artificial intelligence models. Developed in C++, this platform ensures that models run efficiently on different hardware.

snapshot.description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference. Check out the OpenVINO Cheat Sheet and Key Features for a quick reference.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: cathrynlavery/diagram-design offers 52 different types of editorial diagram designs for tools such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. The project provides shadowless and independent visual components prepared in HTML and SVG formats without the need for tools like Mermaid.

snapshot.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 52 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: mvanhorn/last30days-skill offers an AI skill that summarizes topics by conducting research across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the web. Developed with Python, this tool aims to provide the user with a grounded summary by synthesizing data collected from different platforms.

snapshot.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.summary: stitch-skills, developed by Google Labs, is an agent skills library designed to work compatibly with the Stitch MCP server. This library follows open skill standards to ensure compatibility with software such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and the code editor Cursor.

snapshot.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

items.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
items.summary: mjmirza/app-store-compliance is an open-source guide that offers 125 different patterns and solution suggestions to reduce app store rejection reasons. This tool, which helps software developers manage legal compliance processes, also includes a special skill package for AI coding agents.

snapshot.description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 125 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 117 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.

items.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
items.summary: Tracer-Cloud/opensre is an open-source AI agent designed to increase reliability in continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes. Developed in Python, this tool runs by fetching current versions directly from the main directory without requiring administrator privileges during the installation process.

snapshot.description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability. The installer fetches the latest build from main without requiring sudo. If opensre is not found, follow the PATH instructions printed by the installer or open a new terminal.

items.title: toeverything/AFFiNE
items.summary: AFFiNE is a next-generation knowledge base that brings together planning, editing, and content creation processes. This privacy-focused and open-source (source code is open for everyone to access and develop) platform offers a workspace as an alternative to popular tools like Notion and Miro.

snapshot.description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

items.title: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3
items.summary: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3 is a comprehensive download manager that runs on four different platforms and supports almost all download protocols. Developed in Python, this project offers extensible features according to user needs thanks to its plugin-based structure (plugin ecosystem).

snapshot.description: The only downloader you need. 下载器的集大成者。. Started as a passion project to help a Bilibili creator manage resources. Now it ships on four platforms, handles virtually every download protocol, and has a growing Feature Packs plugin ecosystem.

items.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
items.summary: AutoClip is an open-source desktop video editing tool that automatically converts long videos into short clips. The software offers a local-first AI experience by generating subtitles, cover images, and social media text from content such as podcasts or lectures.

snapshot.description: AutoClip｜The open-source OpusClip alternative — local-first AI clipping & MCP server, zero subscriptions. 一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。

items.title: AI made self-hosting fun again
items.summary: AI tools are making self-hosting processes an interesting and accessible pursuit once again. The waning enthusiasm for setting up and managing software infrastructure is on the rise again with the convenience provided by AI.

snapshot.description: I’ve been self-hosting things for many years. There were times when I was quite enthusiastic about it, constantly trying out new software and tinkering with my infrastructure. But at some point, that enthusiasm faded a bit.

items.title: Intel One Mono font (2023)
items.summary: Intel One Mono is a coding font designed by Intel to reduce eye strain during the time developers spend in front of the screen. Offered as open-source on GitHub, this font has character structures specifically developed to increase readability.

snapshot.description: Intel One Mono font repository. Contribute to intel/intel-one-mono development by creating an account on GitHub.

items.title: YouTube Ad Punisher – Auto-reloads YouTube pages when an ad plays
items.summary: YouTube Ad Punisher is a browser extension that automatically refreshes the page when an ad is played on YouTube. This tool acts as an ad blocker and aims to ensure that users have uninterrupted access to content.

snapshot.description: YouTube Ad Blocker - Chrome / Browser Extension. Contribute to antonpictures/youtube-punisher development by creating an account on GitHub.

items.title: Company Culture = Slack Emoji ÷ √Headcount
items.summary: Taking a critical approach to corporate culture measurement methods, this study proposes creating a cultural metric by correlating emoji usage on the internal communication tool Slack with the number of employees. It offers an alternative analysis model based on digital interaction data instead of traditional surveys and HR events.

snapshot.description: Companies spend an enormous amount of time and money trying to measure - and even worse, decide - culture. Engagement surveys, pulse checks, eNPS, offsites where someone from HR asks you to describe the company as a type of animal. Office posters make claims like “our culture is honesty, hard work and fun”, embarrassing the paper they’re printed on.

items.title: Hard Drive pricing has gotten bad
items.summary: It is stated that hard drive prices have increased significantly in the last two years. The author reports that by examining shopping records from previous years, the price of a 20TB capacity disk has risen from $249.99 to $549.99.

snapshot.description: The same 20TB drive went from $249.99 to $549.99 in two Black Fridays. I dug through eight years of receipts, including my ServerPartDeals orders.

items.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini
items.summary: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, shared on Hugging Face, is a multimodal AI model that processes text and image inputs to produce text output. It is designed for general-purpose use in various programming languages as well as English and other languages.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Inkling 2 Mini is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is intended for use in English and other languages, and across multiple coding languages.

items.title: unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF
items.summary: Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF, offered by Unsloth, is an image-to-text model capable of processing visual and text data. Users can train this model with Unsloth or use it with the llama.cpp tool, which allows running large language models on local devices.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. You can also train Inkling 2 via the latest version of Unsloth or run via llama.cpp. See an example of 4-bit Inkling Mini running in Unsloth in Blender + MCP:

items.title: SulphurAI/Sulphur-3
items.summary: Sulphur-3, developed by SulphurAI, is an uncensored video generation model built upon MiniMax H3. This model allows users to generate video content without restrictions.

snapshot.description: An uncensored video generation model based on MiniMax H3.

items.title: AtomicChat/Inkling-2-Mini-Uncensored-GGUF
items.summary: Inkling-2-Mini-Uncensored-GGUF, prepared by AtomicChat, is an AI model capable of processing image and text inputs. As an uncensored version of the Inkling-2-Mini model developed by thinkingmachines, this structure is offered to the user in the form of a LoRA adapter or directly usable GGUF files.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. An uncensored build of thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini by AtomicChat (26.4B MoE, 3.4B active, looped core; text and image input; Apache-2.0, LICENSE in this repo). It comes as a LoRA adapter for any GGUF of AtomicChat/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF and as three ready-made GGUF files with the edit baked in. Every gate we hold it to is measured below, and the two it misses are shown.

items.title: prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2.5-27B-GGUF
items.summary: prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2.5-27B-GGUF is a 27-billion parameter text generation model developed for AI agents. Optimized for agent-based workflows, the model can run on CUDA, Metal, and CPU via the llama.cpp library.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. A 27B ternary model built for agents, for llama.cpp (CUDA, Metal, CPU)

items.title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face discusses context engineering methods used to guide large language models (LLMs) without requiring an intensive training process. This approach focuses on automating processes by having large language models derive general instructions from their own experiences.

snapshot.description: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it rema

items.title: InitFree-SfM: When Initialization-Free Bundle Adjustment meets Learned Structure-from-Motion
items.summary: InitFree-SfM presents a bundle adjustment method that does not require a prior global estimate in Structure-from-Motion processes, making it independent of initial values. The study aims to resolve the discrepancy between the target value and realistic reconstruction in optimizations performed with random initial values.

snapshot.description: Initialization-free bundle adjustment (InitFree BA) aims to jointly recover camera poses and scene structure without requiring an initial global estimate. It is a very challenging problem, especially compared to traditional BA where a good estimation is assumed. While recent methods optimize surrogate Object Space Error (OSE) objectives from random initialization, a low objective value does not necessarily yield an accurate reconstruction, revealing a gap between optimization and reconstruction.

items.title: So Many Ways to Multiply 3times3 Matrices: A Large Dataset of Rank-23 Schemes
items.summary: The dataset shared on Hugging Face brings together 62,029 different rank-23 schemes for 3x3 matrix multiplication. Obtained through gradient descent and alternating least squares methods, these schemes are based on the best-known and optimally accepted rank values for matrix multiplication operations.

snapshot.description: A publicly available dataset of 62029 rank-23 schemes for 3times3 matrix multiplication is presented. Every scheme in it has its own rank pattern, an invariant formed by the ranks of the factor matrices of a scheme, so all schemes are pairwise inequivalent. The schemes were obtained by a numerical method combining gradient descent with alternating least squares and by flip graph search, and have ternary, integer or rational coefficients. items.title: Pretrained Tabular Features and the Measurement of Financial Proximity
items.summary: Pretrained Tabular Features and the Measurement of Financial Proximity presents a study examining return interactions between financial assets using spatial arbitrage pricing theory (S-APT). The article addresses the performance of tabular foundation models in financial applications and the limited interpretability of these models in areas requiring transparency.

snapshot.description: Spatial arbitrage pricing theory (S-APT) extends factor models to allow returns to spill over between connected firms, beyond what common risk factors explain. In recent years, tabular foundation models (TFMs) have matched or outperformed tuned gradient-boosted and bagged ensembles on small and medium-sized tabular benchmarks. Although their predictive performance is strong, these models reveal little about what they have learned, which limits their use in regulated financial applications that r

items.title: Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety
items.summary: The article 'Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety', published on Hugging Face, proposes that AI should respond to queries containing visual context with four different actions—allow, warn, review, and refuse—instead of simply refusing. This approach uses a benchmark set called JudiBench and a large training dataset to base safety decisions on verifiable evidence.

snapshot.description: When visual context makes an ordinary request unsafe to answer as asked, a blanket refusal may leave the user's need unresolved. Choosing how to help requires distinguishing an established hazard from a condition that still needs verification, a distinction that binary safety labels leave unspecified. glossary.explanation: The systematic research process conducted to find bugs and security vulnerabilities in software.
Expert team work that mimics the methods of malicious attackers to test the security of a system.
Predefined functional capabilities that AI agents can use to perform a specific task.
A method of quickly instructing software by typing short commands starting with a slash in the chat interface.
A set of fundamental rules and tools that provide a specific order and structure while developing software, making tasks easier.
A text-based interface that allows you to manage programs by entering written commands instead of using a mouse.
Artificial intelligence models trained on vast amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
A data collection process that automatically copies data from websites and saves it in an organized format.
A package of ready-made tools and libraries that enables developers to build programs faster for a specific platform or application.
A tool that prevents system overload by distributing incoming internet traffic evenly across multiple servers.
An intermediary server that handles requests coming over the internet, directs them to the relevant servers, and enhances security.
A type of software where the source code is open for anyone to inspect, modify, and improve.
The process by which a trained artificial intelligence model processes new data to make a prediction or generate a result.
A collection of specialized capabilities that artificial intelligence agents possess to perform complex tasks.
A process that ensures software updates are automatically tested and deployed quickly and error-free.
A structure that allows the core features of a software to be extended with small, subsequently added programs.
